title: Smooth algebras over an essentially smooth base have localization models
statement: Let $R,A,Q$ be commutative rings with compatible algebra structures $R\to A\to Q$. If $A$ is essentially smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map] and $Q$ is smooth over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], then in any universe containing that of $R$ there is a smooth $R$-algebra $P$, an $R$-compatible algebra map $P\to Q$, and a multiplicative subset $S$ such that $Q$ is its localization [def-weil-pbc-module-localization].

source.place: Tags 00CR, 0CAQ, 00T3, 00TD and 00DK; agent-written combination, verified online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0CAQ and /tag/00CR and /tag/00DK

proof.text: Write A as a localization of a smooth R-algebra C, transferring the C-algebra structure along its R-algebra equivalence. To use the single-universe colimit interface, note that a localization of C is small in the universe of C, and that Q is small there because it is of finite type over A. Shrink A and Q to that universe. Apply the principal-localization colimit theorem to C and S; compose its colimit ring isomorphism with the localization equivalence to the shrunken A. Smoothness of Q over this colimit follows by smooth composition with that isomorphism. Apply filtered-colimit smooth descent to obtain a stage and its smooth algebra P.

Transport the stage algebra to C_s using the stage ring isomorphism. Its inverse is a smooth map, so smooth composition gives smoothness over C_s. The colimit coprojection identity and its compatibility with C prove the scalar tower C to C_s to A. Replace the tensor base ring by C_s using the two inverse scalar towers and tensor compatibility; replace the colimit factor by A using tensor congruence. Algebra-map compatibility of the resulting isomorphism is checked by taking preimages under the ring equivalence. Transport the shrunken A and Q back and lift P to the common universe; the tensor congruence on the right factor transports its model isomorphism.

The principal localization C_s is smooth over C, and therefore over R. Smooth composition now shows P is smooth over R. Because the powers of s lie in S, C_s to A is a localization at the image of S. Its tensor base change to P is a localization by IsLocalization.tensorRight. Give Q the P-algebra structure obtained from the inverse tensor model isomorphism and transport this localization to Q. The tensor balancing identity and the A-linearity of the isomorphism prove the scalar tower R to P to Q.

P is finite type over R, so Algebra.FiniteType.small makes it small in the requested universe max u t. Use Shrink.algEquiv to transfer its ring and R-algebra structures. Compose the map P to Q with this equivalence; its compatibility with R proves the final scalar tower. Smooth.of_equiv transfers smoothness and IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_base_ringEquiv transfers the submonoid and localization property. These are the witnesses of the stated existential.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_localization_model
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (Q : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing Q]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra A Q] [Algebra R Q] [IsScalarTower R A Q]
    (hA : EssentiallySmooth R A) (hQ : Smooth A Q) :
    ∃ (P : Type (max u t)) (hP : CommRing P),
      letI : CommRing P := hP
      ∃ (hRP : Algebra R P),
        letI : Algebra R P := hRP
        ∃ (hPQ : Algebra P Q),
          letI : Algebra P Q := hPQ
          IsScalarTower R P Q ∧ Smooth R P ∧
            ∃ (S : Submonoid P), IsLocalization S Q
